name: tr_lowry
caption:
IF KYLE LOWRY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐶 Snubbull: bares its fangs and makes a scary face. Our bulldog, traded to us in 2012
🛡️ Wobbuffet: does nothing but endure attacks, then counters. The charges-drawn leader since they started tracking it
🥚 Blissey: rushes over to share an egg of happiness. Our all-time assists leader
🦊 Thievul: stalks its target and steals when it least expects it. Our all-time steals leader
✨ Mew: can learn any move. 16 triple-doubles, our franchise record
🐕 Granbull: one look at its fangs and most foes run. 26 points and 10 assists in Finals Game 6, our first title. July 2026: a one-day deal to retire with us

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Kyle Lowry had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF KYLE LOWRY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Snubbull. It bares its fangs and makes a scary face. Twenty twelve: we trade for a guard everybody compares to a bulldog.
beats.dlg: IT BARES ITS FANGS.|2012: OUR BULLDOG ARRIVES

beats.vo: Wobbuffet. It does nothing but endure attacks, then it counters. Kyle took more charges than anyone since the league started counting.
beats.dlg: IT ENDURES, THEN COUNTERS.|THE CHARGES DRAWN LEADER

beats.vo: Blissey. It rushes over to share an egg of happiness with anyone. Kyle shared it more than anyone: our all-time leader in assists.
beats.dlg: IT SHARES EGGS OF JOY.|OUR ALL-TIME ASSISTS KING

beats.vo: Thievul. It stalks its target, then steals when it least expects it. Our all-time leader in steals, too.
beats.dlg: STEALS WHEN YOU LOOK AWAY.|OUR ALL-TIME STEALS KING

beats.vo: Mew. It can learn any move. Sixteen triple-doubles, the most in our history.
beats.dlg: IT CAN LEARN ANY MOVE.|16 TRIPLE-DOUBLES! RECORD

beats.vo: And the ace. Granbull. One look at its fangs and most foes run. Game six of the Finals: twenty-six points, ten assists, our first title. And this summer, he signed a one-day deal to retire with us.
beats.dlg: MOST FOES RUN FROM IT.|FINALS G6: 26 PTS, 10 AST

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Lowry: traded to the Raptors by Houston in July 2012 (Toronto 2012-2021); compared to a pit bull or bulldog; NBA's charges drawn leader for the play-by-play era (tracked since 2000-01); Raptors all-time leader in assists, steals, three-pointers and triple-doubles (16 of the 30 in Raptors history); Game 6 of the 2019 Finals: 26 points, 10 assists, 7 rebounds in the 114-110 title clincher; on July 7, 2026 he signed a one-day contract to retire with the Raptors
